card.text: Rapidly spinning, elongated dwarf planet with a ring.

introduction.text: Haumea turns once every 3.9 hours. It has two moons, Hiʻiaka and Namaka.

color.title: Whole-disc colour and albedo
color.summary: Haumea's measured average colour and brightness, spread evenly. The surface is unresolved: no terrain or markings.

illustration.title: NASA artist's texture
illustration.summary: NASA's illustrated surface from its 3D model. None of it was observed, and its longitudes are arbitrary.
